metadata_caption: She said the whole pizza was personal sized! 😂 backstory ::: Kay and I have been so busy the last several weeks. I feel like we never get a second to sit down and be together, so when she asked if we could have a movie night this weekend, I decided to plan a fun and memorable date night. ❤️ For once we had an afternoon/evening together due to Kay’s contraction pains being too overbearing for our original plans, so I went to the store and bought an assortment of pizza-making ingredients, and pumpkins for carving. I decided that along with the movie, we could do some festive activities. After setting up the living room, I went and got Kay, who I’d asked to stay in the room while I set up our date night. She was so excited with the spooky date night activities and decorations! She especially liked that I rearranged the modular couch to look like a bed! We made pizzas and watched a scary movie. It was a much needed night of bonding for us! ❤️ #kayandtayofficial #couples #relationships #pregnant
